description: Small, reproducible real-world research case-study dataset for the ResearchCollision evaluation. Every source paper is a real, publicly traceable scholarly record retrieved from OpenAlex at build time. Machine-generated annotations (provider topic labels, a heuristic expected-evidence set) are labeled as such; research-gap annotations are marked 'none' because no independent expert annotation is available; no human annotations are fabricated.
